title: Nothing to post means no journal entry
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location is connected to QuickBooks Online, with Inventory Asset and Cost of Parts mapped on its ShopView Accounts page, and that AccountingHub is not enabled.
  • Have access to the QuickBooks Online company of the test location, so its journal entries can be read.
  • Make sure the General Internal category is mapped to an expense account, account X, at the test location.
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Complete, with one approved labor line of 2.0 hours only and Shop supplies $0.00.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 2, for internal customer A, closed, with one approved line with one stock part picked from inventory at a cost of $40.00 each, quantity 2, so an entry for a closed work order can be seen.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Close Work Order in the work order header.
  3. Click Close Work Order in the confirmation.
  4. In QuickBooks Online, open the journal entries for work order 1's number.
  5. In QuickBooks Online, open the journal entries for work order 2's number.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The Close confirmation opens.

Step 3:

  • The work order shows the status Closed.

Step 4:

  • No journal entry exists for work order 1.

Step 5:

  • Work order 2's $80.00 entry is there.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order), story SV-11764 (Story 7, QuickBooks Online sync)

  • S7-N4: “If the work order has no costed stock parts, no reclass and a shop supplies amount of $0.00, no journal entry is sent.”
  • S3-E1: “If the work order has no parts, the confirmation shows "Parts cost $0.00"; Close posts no parts entry, posts the shop supplies entry when the amount is above $0.00 (S10-E2), and still creates the internal invoice.”
